clock.title: Price clock
clock.subtitle: Every price the API returned before the match, with its exact minute
clock.explain: It is structured from the raw /odds bodies that are already stored (RAW), without asking the provider for anything new. Reading only: it changes no pick, no probability and not the SHADOW mode. A new price is recorded the first time it was seen with that value, not every time it was asked.
clock.empty: No body has been structured yet. The job runs in the worker every 10 minutes, a few hundred bodies per round.
clock.pendingHint: Bodies the current version has not finished
clock.ledgerHelp: Each raw body ends up read, empty, waiting for its match, after kick-off or failed. Those waiting or failed are retried on their own for 14 days.
clock.familiesHelp: Only the marked markets are structured. The rest stays intact in RAW and can be read later without losing anything.
clock.countsLate: The per-market count took longer than allowed; it is retried on the next refresh.
clock.subject: Subject
clock.issuesHelp: Whatever could not be structured stays here with its reason; nothing is hidden. A body's detail is found by its identifier in RAW.
clock.unclassifiedHelp: The provider sent these bet types and the taxonomy does not know them yet. Nothing is lost: their prices are still in RAW.

matrix.title: Market matrix by family
matrix.subtitle: What each kind of bet can become: its price, its results, its model and the verdict
matrix.explain: For each kind of bet: whether the provider offers it, whether we store its price and the figure that would settle it, whether a model exists yet and the verdict that earns. It is read from the newest stored matrix, as it was measured at the time shown. Reading only: it changes no pick, no probability and not the SHADOW mode.
matrix.empty: No matrix has been stored yet: one is built every week (or with python -m scripts.markets matrix --store).
matrix.stale: Matrix from an earlier version ({version}; the current one is {current}): it is renewed by the weekly run.
matrix.definitionsHint: {extracted} with a stored price, {withRule} with a settlement rule
matrix.legend: Ready: a model, a calibrator and an edge validated against the closing line. Partial: a model prices it and the pipeline runs it, but its edge is not validated. To investigate: it can be graded and there is a price to measure it against, but there is no model yet; the priority says where to start. Not viable: nothing to grade it on or no price to measure it against, or it was judged not worth it.
matrix.howToRead: Bets: with a stored price / total the provider offers. Price: matches with a price in the last {price} days, median number of houses per match and coverage (the share of matches with any price that have this market's). Results: finished matches of the followed competitions in the last {results} days that carry the figure that would settle the market, and their share of the total.
matrix.estimatedHint: Figure from the weekly discovery run: the platform does not store this market's prices yet.
matrix.curatedHint: Verdict from a documented judgement: the data alone does not give it.

reason.priced: priced and with results: it can be measured
reason.thin_price: fewer than 2 houses: the price cannot be measured
reason.not_extracted: the platform does not store its prices yet
reason.not_offered: the provider does not offer it
reason.no_period_data: no per-half data: it cannot be settled
reason.out_of_scope: outside the plan (timing, specials, other sports)
reason.no_data: we do not store the figure that would settle it
reason.low_information: little information: not worth a model
reason.kind_not_graded: its kind of bet is not graded on this figure
reason.not_understood: its selections are not read yet
